_why: pi harness: hub plugin loaded ephemerally from npm each launch, pinned via piPluginSpec (the -e flag overrides any package pin in settings). Per-seat PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/settings.json and models.json are rendered from this OIS config source; do not rely on ~/.pi/agent or workspace .pi fallback for seat-critical Pi policy. WHICH provider/model a seat runs is NOT declared here — it is the cell's piProvider/piModel resolved against the fleet.json .providers catalog. This file holds only harness-wide UI/compaction baseline that is true of every pi seat regardless of model.
_piSettingsWhy: defaultProvider/defaultModel are deliberately ABSENT: render_pi_settings derives them from the cell's piProvider/piModel — the same pair that builds the exec flags — so the rendered seat file cannot disagree with the model the seat actually runs. Restating them here is what allowed that drift, and it stayed invisible while every cell was codex.
_piModelsWhy: The piModels block was REMOVED, not emptied. Model windows and provider endpoints now live once in fleet.json .providers and render_pi_models derives the seat's models.json from the cell's selected entry. A harness-level model table could only ever describe one provider, which is why adding a second endpoint needed an ois edit before.
